Inborn D-2-hydroxyglutarate metabolic disorder; developmental impairment affects nearly all, and intrinsic cardiomyopathy occurs in roughly half of type 2 patients.

Acute myeloid neoplasm of blood and bone marrow; no subtype-specific common extramedullary organ involvement is established.
